title: Flags Quiz — Learn Every Country Flag, Capital and Map
excerpt: Free flag, capital, map and country-shape quizzes covering all 197 countries. Play instantly, no sign-up. Learn the flags you keep getting wrong.
content_html:
The same countries split three ways, by how often people actually get them wrong. Start easy and work up — each level keeps its own progress.

The same games applied to the geography that is not a country — states, rivers and oceans.

Ten ways to play the same countries. Switch any time — your progress follows you.

Hardest flags to guess

The flags people get wrong most often — obscure designs with close look-alikes. Ranked, with what makes each one difficult.

Flags that look the same

Chad and Romania, Monaco and Indonesia, Ireland and Côte d'Ivoire. Every confusable flag pair, with the detail that separates them.

Red, white and blue flags

All the national flags using red, white and blue — far more than most people expect, and a common source of quiz mistakes.

Newest flags

The most recently adopted national flags, from the newest design backwards, with the year each one came into use.

Oldest flags

The oldest national flag designs still flying today, ordered by the year each was adopted.

Flags with animals

Every national flag featuring an animal — eagles, lions, birds of paradise and one dragon. With what each animal represents.

How this site works

Every quiz here runs on the same set of 197 countries and territories, with flags, capitals, land area, population and borders drawn from one dataset. Pick a continent or a smaller region and the questions narrow to it.

Wrong answers are chosen deliberately rather than at random. A question about Chad will offer Romania; a question about Monaco will offer Indonesia. Guessing by elimination does not work, which is the point — those are exactly the pairs people get wrong in real life.

When a round ends you get a list of what you missed, and each entry links to a page about that flag: which colours it uses, when it was adopted, its proportions, and the flags it is most often confused with.

There is no account and no score history on a server. Your per-item accuracy is kept in your own browser so flashcard mode can lead with the items you are weakest on, and nothing is sent anywhere.

Frequently asked questions

Which quiz should I start with?

Start with the world flags quiz above. It draws from all 197 countries and shows you immediately which regions you are weakest in.

Do the quizzes work on a phone?

Yes. The map quizzes support pinch-to-zoom and drag, and every other mode is designed for one-handed use.

How do I learn the flags I keep getting wrong?

Every result screen lists what you missed, and each entry links to a page explaining that flag: its colours, its history, and the flags it is most often confused with.

content_html_zh:
同样的国家根据人们实际犯错的频率分为三种方式。 轻松开始，逐步提高——每个级别都有自己的进度。

同样的游戏也适用于非国家的地理区域——州、河流和海洋。

玩同一个国家的十种方式。 随时切换——你的进步随你而动。

最难猜的标志

人们最常犯错的标志是外观相似、晦涩难懂的设计。 排名，以及每一项的难度。

看起来相同的标志

乍得和罗马尼亚、摩纳哥和印度尼西亚、爱尔兰和科特迪瓦。 每对容易混淆的标志，以及分隔它们的细节。

红、白、蓝旗

所有国旗都使用红色、白色和蓝色——远远超出大多数人的预期，也是测验错误的常见来源。

最新旗帜

最近采用的国旗，从最新设计向后看，以及每个国旗的使用年份。

最古老的旗帜

至今仍在飘扬的最古老的国旗设计，按每种设计的采用年份排序。

带有动物的旗帜

每面国旗上都有一种动物——鹰、狮子、天堂鸟和一条龙。 每个动物代表什么。

这个网站是如何运作的

这里的每个测验都在同一组 197 个国家和地区进行，其国旗、首都、土地面积、人口和边界均来自一个数据集。 选择一个大陆或更小的地区，然后将问题范围缩小到该地区。

错误的答案是故意选择的，而不是随机选择的。 关于乍得的问题将向罗马尼亚提出；关于摩纳哥的问题将向印度尼西亚提出。 通过消除来猜测是行不通的，这就是重点——这些正是人们在现实生活中出错的对。

当一轮结束时，你会得到一个你错过的内容的列表，每个条目都链接到一个关于该旗帜的页面：它使用的颜色、何时采用、它的比例以及最常与它混淆的旗帜。

服务器上没有帐户，也没有分数历史记录。 您的每个项目的准确性都保存在您自己的浏览器中，因此抽认卡模式可以引导您最弱的项目，并且不会将任何内容发送到任何地方。

常见问题

Which quiz should I start with?

从上面的世界国旗测验开始。 它涵盖了所有 197 个国家/地区，并立即向您显示您最薄弱的地区。

Do the quizzes work on a phone?

是的。 地图测验支持捏合缩放和拖动，所有其他模式均专为单手使用而设计。

How do I learn the flags I keep getting wrong?

每个结果屏幕都会列出您错过的内容，每个条目都链接到一个解释该标志的页面：它的颜色、它的历史以及最常与它混淆的标志。
